hook: Nov 15 missed: Water Board now plans *40 MGD* Godavari trial run
hook_b: Nov 15 missed: Water Board now plans *40 MGD* Godavari trial run
tldr: HMWSSB is preparing a trial run to divert an extra 40 MGD of Godavari water from Mallannasagar to the Ghanpur Master Balancing Reservoir. The Nov 15 target slipped after crews hit heavy rock along a 150 m forest stretch; officials set a two-day deadline on Nov 20 to finish the interconnection.

beats.what: Pipeline integration is nearly done; HMWSSB and Mission Bhagiratha set a two-day deadline for the rest.
beats.why: El Nino conditions are draining the Singur and Manjira reservoirs.
beats.care: Singur-Manjira-fed areas face a supply deficit; the extra water is expected to offset about 50% of it.
